The 'Skincare, slowly.' tagline is now bigger than the 'Lumen & Fig' logo, so the hierarchy is flipped. The fig mark is pushed against the ellipse's left edge, and a large empty band separates the logo from the tagline. B's tagline sits only a few pixels lower than A's, which is not enough to tell them apart.
